title: The Sun is not an average star
description:
Jupiter is the biggest planet, but it would take nearly a thousand Jupiters to fill the Sun (by volume). And the Sun is no average star: it is bigger and brighter than over 90% of the stars near us, because most of them are small, dim red dwarfs, like our nearest neighbour, Proxima Centauri.
